meanings.note: Male sibling; also friendly address, like 'bro'
title of a monk: брат Всеволод

examples.text: Мой старший брат живёт в Москве.
examples.trans: My older brother lives in Moscow.

examples.text: Нет, брат, танк я не могу чинить.
examples.trans: No, bro, I can't fix a tank.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Аркаша, губернатор хочет с нами встретиться!
examples.trans: Arkasha, the governor wants to meet with us!

выстрелить.gloss: to shoot, to fire a shot

meanings.en: to shoot, to fire a shot

examples.trans: The partisan shot me in the back.

examples.text: Ай, партизан выстрелил мне в спину!
examples.trans: Ow, the partisan shot me in the back!

meanings.note: a brave person; also the main character of a story

examples.text: Всё, теперь ты герой? И можно только пить?
examples.trans: So now you're a hero? And all you have to do is drink?

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)

examples.text: Особенно когда ты её за грудь хватал.
examples.trans: Especially when you were grabbing her breast.

examples.text: Он выстрелил в меня и попал в грудь.
examples.trans: He shot at me and hit me in the chest.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.trans: Open the door. Is this flat nine?

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.note: imperative держи! when handing something over

examples.trans: Here you go, this is for you.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?
emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Of course, everything is recorded on camera.

examples.text: Нужно ходить по городу с камерой!
examples.trans: You need to walk around town with a camera!
Then invite me to the movies.
So, let's look at the schedule in the cinema.

examples.text: Зачем ты вообще ведёшь её в кино?
examples.trans: Why are you even taking her to the movies?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

examples.text: Это хорошо, что готово. А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: It's good that it's ready. We were starting to worry.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Нина, не слушай. Это опять обман.
examples.trans: Nina, don't listen. It's another trick.
Stop, why did you take a pistol?
The officer put the pistol away in its holster.

examples.text: Стой, ты зачем пистолет взял? Ты что, с ума сошёл? Дай сюда!
examples.trans: Stop, why did you take a pistol? Are you out of your mind? Give it here!
We started living in a new way.

examples.text: Всё по-новому. Нам сейчас никто не будет мешать.
examples.trans: Everything is new now. No one is going to bother us now.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

meanings.en: to get to, to end up
meanings.note: как попасть в центр? = how do I get to the centre?

examples.trans: A firework hit the power station.
How do I get to the station?

examples.text: Скажи: салют попал в станцию. Три района без света.
examples.trans: Say a firework hit the power station. Three districts without electricity.

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

examples.text: Мы же только начинаем. Через месяц будет пять тысяч.
examples.trans: But we're only just starting. In a month there'll be five thousand.

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

meanings.note: fleeting vowel о drops in oblique cases: рта, рту, ртом; locative во рту

examples.text: Самсонов, рот закрой! Зачем ты его обижаешь?
examples.trans: Samsonov, shut your mouth! Why are you insulting him?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Секунду! = One second! / Just a moment!

examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.
One second. I'll call Mishkin right now.

examples.text: Этот материал слишком старый и скучный.
examples.trans: This material is far too old and boring.
She seems a bit boring to me.

снимать.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent

examples.trans: Watch. I'm taking off my ring.

related.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent (pf)

examples.trans: Let's film it in a new, modern way.
Stop, you cannot go any further!
Stop, that's a wrap! Good job, Samson!

meanings.note: discharge a weapon repeatedly or generally

examples.trans: Who is shooting in the forest?
The soldiers are shooting at targets.

meanings.note: выйти на сцену = to go out on stage

meanings.en: scene (in a play, film, or argument)

examples.text: А на сцену выходит — превращается в дерево.
examples.trans: But when she goes out on stage, she turns into a tree.
The actors came out onto the stage.

examples.text: Работает она много. А на сцену выходит — превращается в дерево.
examples.trans: She works a lot. But when she goes out on stage, she turns into a tree.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

meanings.note: 'mum will kill me' = I'll be in big trouble

examples.trans: Do you want to kill me?

examples.text: Ты смотришь на меня так, как будто убить хочешь.
examples.trans: You look at me as if you want to kill me.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Леночка, дорогая, жди меня сегодня к четырём.
examples.trans: Lenochka, darling, expect me today by four.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
